# Homestallers

> Trusted home help in Jacksonville, Florida. Flat-price TV mounting, furniture assembly, smart home and camera setup, tech help, moving help, pressure washing and handyman jobs. Led by local, experienced professional Alex Montalbano. Book and pay online.

## Key facts
- Business: Homestallers, Jacksonville, FL (homestallers.com)
- Owner: Alex Montalbano
- Service area: Duval, St. Johns, Clay and Nassau counties, up to 30 miles from central Jacksonville
- Hours: 7 days a week, 8am to 6pm
- Phone and text: (631) 304-4809
- Email: homestallers@gmail.com
- Pricing: flat package price that includes a set amount of time; $80 per hour after that, only with the customer's OK; parts at cost; package price stays the same if a job finishes early
- Travel fee: none within 10 miles of central Jacksonville; $35 flat from 11 to 30 miles
- Payment: online at booking (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay via Stripe); extra time and parts paid the same day in cash or online
- A 3% service fee is added to online bookings and payments (not tips)
- Not offered: electrical, plumbing, HVAC or roofing work (licensed services coming soon)

## Common questions
- How much is TV mounting in Jacksonville? $100 flat per TV with 1 hour included, or $150 with the wires hidden in the wall.
- Do you work weekends? Yes, 7 days a week, 8am to 6pm.
- Do you mount TVs on concrete block or plaster walls? Yes, with the right masonry or plaster anchors.
- Is there a travel fee? None within 10 miles of central Jacksonville, $35 flat from 11 to 30 miles.
- Do you do electrical or plumbing work? Not yet. Those services are coming soon, done by a licensed contractor.
